name: Growring
description: A ring with a constant outer edge and a bore that opens across the sheet.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-mask: radial-gradient(circle closest-side at 50% 50%, transparent @calc(4 + 38 * @x / @X)%, #000 @calc(4 + 38 * @x / @X)% 48%, transparent 48%); mask: radial-gradient(circle closest-side at 50% 50%, transparent @calc(4 + 38 * @x / @X)%, #000 @calc(4 + 38 * @x / @X)% 48%, transparent 48%); } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
